gear.why: SKELETONS RESIST EDGES. skel.kod:73 sets pierce and thrust to 70 and BLUDGEON to -20 — negative, so blunt does EXTRA. BatteredSkeleton is Skeleton and does not override it, so the whole family this fleet hunts is the same. A long sword thrusts: 70% resisted. Maces and hammers bludgeon; axes slash, which is not in the table at all, so neutral.

sell_why: Spares of these are dead weight and they pile up: one character held TEN long swords and FIVE knight's shields, thirty stacks against a max_carry of 14, and merchants refused to hand over a mace because of it. The worn one is never at risk — plUsing is the server's own list and no sell list can take the shield off an arm — so this sheds only the surplus. Swords are on it twice over: skeletons resist thrust at 70 (skel.kod:73), so a sword is not a weapon this fleet should be carrying at all.
